# waroom-client-go

The [Waroom](https://waroom.com/) Client SDK is the official Go client library for interacting with the Waroom API.

> [!WARNING]
> The API of this library is not stable yet.

## Docs

### Official Documentation

This SDK provides a Go interface to the Waroom API, automatically generated from the OpenAPI specification using Ogen.
The implementation follows OpenAPI Specification standards and provides type-safe access to all Waroom API endpoints.

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/waroom/waroom-client-go)
- [Waroom Backend Repository](https://github.com/topotal/waroom-backend)
- [Waroom API Documentation](https://docs.waroom.com/11871aebe5dd80898ffbe32cbf38d74e)
- [Waroom API Implementation](https://github.com/topotal/waroom-backend/tree/master/app/controllers/api/v0)
- [Open API Specification](https://swagger.io/specification/)
	- [OAS Waroom Schema](./api/openapi.yaml)
- [Ogen](https://ogen.dev/docs/intro/)

## Examples

- [Examples](https://github.com/waroom/waroom-client-go/tree/main/example): List of example files demonstrating SDK usage.
	- `example/services/main.go`: Service API usage
	- `example/incidents/main.go`: Incident API usage
	- `example/labels/main.go`: Label API usage

## Project Structure

### Core Components

- `waroom/`: Main SDK package providing high-level client interfaces
	- Hand-written runtime:
		- `client.go`: Core client initialization and configuration (functional options)
		- `auth.go`: Authentication handling (Bearer token via SecuritySource)
		- `errors.go`: Typed `APIError` + sentinel errors (`ErrNotFound` etc., usable with `errors.Is`)
		- `pagination.go`: Shared `Pagination` metadata struct and auto-pagination helper
	- Generated by genwaroom (`*_gen.go`, do not edit manually):
		- `client_gen.go`: Service accessors (`client.Incidents()` etc.)
		- `services_gen.go` / `incidents_gen.go` / `labels_gen.go`: Per-resource service methods
		- `types_gen.go`: Public type aliases of ogen-generated types

- `internal/ogen/`: Auto-generated code from OpenAPI specification
	- Generated by Ogen from `openapi.yaml`
	- Low-level API client implementation
	- Request/response types and validators
	- Do not edit manually

- `internal/cmd/genwaroom/`: Second-stage code generator (two stages)
	- `genwaroom analyze`: reads the compiled `internal/ogen` package via
	  go/packages and derives `api/sdk-model.yaml`, a committed semantic model
	  of the public SDK surface (review its diff to see API changes; never
	  edit it by hand)
	- `genwaroom render`: generates the public `waroom/*_gen.go` facade from
	  `api/sdk-model.yaml`
	- See `internal/cmd/genwaroom/doc.go` for the conventions it relies on
	- Configured via `.genwaroom.yaml` (include/skip lists, rename overrides)

- `internal/httpx/`: HTTP utilities
	- Custom HTTP transport middleware
	- User-Agent handling
	- Request/response debugging utilities

- `example/`: Example code demonstrating SDK usage

### Currently Implemented Features

- **Service Management**
	- List services
	- Get service details
	- Service label operations

- **Incident Management**
	- List incidents
	- Get incident details
	- Create/update incidents

- **Label Management**
	- List labels
	- Get label details
	- Create/update/delete labels

### Key Dependencies

- **Go Version**: 1.25.1+
- **Testing Framework**: testify v1.10.0+
- **Code Generator**: [ogen](https://ogen.dev/docs/intro/) v1.16.0
- **HTTP Client**: Standard library `net/http` with custom middleware
- **Waroom Backend API (internal)**

### Development Tools

- **Task Runner**: Uses [Taskfile](https://taskfile.dev/) for common operations
	- `task fetch:openapi`: Fetch latest OpenAPI schema (implementation pending)
	- `task gen`: Generate code from OpenAPI specification using Ogen
	- `task test`: Run unit tests

- **Code Generator**: [Ogen](https://ogen.dev/) - Generates Go code from OpenAPI specification
	- Configured via `generate.go`
	- Outputs to `internal/ogen/`

## Implementation Guidelines

### Client Configuration

The SDK provides flexible client configuration options:

```go
client, err := waroom.NewClient(ctx,
    waroom.WithBaseURL("https://api.waroom.com/api/v0"),
    waroom.WithHTTPClient(customHTTPClient),
    waroom.WithUserAgent("my-app/1.0"),
    waroom.WithRequestDump(),  // Enable request debugging
    waroom.WithResponseDump(), // Enable response debugging
)
```

### Authentication

All API requests require authentication via Bearer token:
- Set via environment variables or pass through context
- Handled automatically by `auth.go`
- Follow Waroom API authentication guidelines

### Adding New API Endpoints

1. Update the OpenAPI specification (`openapi.yaml`)
2. Add the operationId to `include:` in `.genwaroom.yaml` (or remove the list to generate everything)
3. Run `task gen` — this regenerates both `internal/ogen/` and the public `waroom/*_gen.go` facade
4. Add examples in `example/` directory
5. Add tests for new functionality (`task gen:check` guards against generated-code drift in CI)

### Testing Approach

- **Unit Tests**: Standard Go tests for wrapper functions
- **Integration Tests**: Test against Waroom API (requires valid credentials)
- Use testify assertions for clean test code
- Mock HTTP responses for isolated unit tests

### Error Handling

- Handle HTTP errors appropriately (404, 401, 500, etc.)
- Return meaningful error messages to callers
- Log important operations for debugging
- Follow Go error handling best practices

### Code Style

- Follow standard Go conventions (gofmt, golint)
- Document exported functions and types
- Keep wrapper functions simple and focused
- Prefer composition over inheritance
